name: DECISION — Choose the mobile strategy (A / B / C) and rebuild the increment plan
description:
OBJECTIVE
Run the design review of the three mobile strategy mockups (Approach A / B / C) and bring ONE decision to management, with options, cost in time, recommendation and a decide-by deadline.

INPUTS (must be produced before this task starts)
- docs/mobile/mobile-current-status.md (task M0 — current state audit)
- docs/mobile/strategy-A-app-shell.html + strategy-A-notes.md (bottom tab bar + stack navigation)
- docs/mobile/strategy-B-drawer.html + strategy-B-notes.md (drawer + contextual app bar, incremental)
- docs/mobile/strategy-C-responsive.html + strategy-C-notes.md (one responsive layout, no mobile fork)

WHAT TO DO
1. Verify the three mockups exist and open; check each against the audit defects D1–D9 and record which defects each approach actually fixes.
2. Build the comparison table: approach · defects fixed · defects left · effort range (optimistic/likely/pessimistic) · risk · impact on desktop mode (dockview) · migration order · demoability of the first increment.
3. Write the recommendation as ProjectManager: prefer the option with the best deployable-first path, not the tidiest end state. State the recommendation and why.
4. Prepare the 5-minute demo script: what to show, in which order, which mockup screens, which questions management must answer.
5. Publish the decision request in the task reply using the standing report format (TL;DR first, then increment plan table with deployable/demoable flags, then decisions needed with options + recommendation + decide-by).
6. Once management answers, update this task with the chosen approach and move the milestone tasks (M1–M4) out of onhold with their owners and dates.

CONSTRAINTS
- No code. Decision material only.
- Do not promise dates to management that the development tasks have not confirmed: keep them as forecasts (ranges) and say so.

ACCEPTANCE
- Comparison table + recommendation + demo script written in the task.
- Every approach has an explicit "defects fixed / defects not fixed" list.
- A dated decision request to management exists (decide-by expressed as working days from the demo).
